title: Okukuuma kw’Abafiiriddwa
intro: Ogenda okusisinkana emmeeme egezeseddwa okwawukana okusinga obuziba, ng’amaaso gaayo gamanyi olulimi lw’amaziga naye ng’omutima gwagwo tegufiirwa ssuubi. Mu mboozi ey’obulimba, okwegomba, n’okukkakkana nga bazzeemu okugatta, omuddu wa Allah ono ow’ekitiibwa yafuuka akabonero k’obugumiikiriza emirembe gyonna. Ani yagumira emyaka egy’obulumi obw’ekyama, kyokka n’addamu okulaba n’essanyu mu kaseera kamu?
clues: Ndi nnabbi erinnya lye eryafuuka akabonero k’obugumiikiriza mu maaso g’okufiirwa okunene.
Nafuna omukisa okuzaala abaana ab’obulenzi bangi, naye omu yanzigyako obuggya bw’abalala.
Okwagala kwange eri oyo eyabula kwali kwa maanyi nnyo ne kiba nti amaaso gange ne geeru olw’ennaku, naye ate nga sikyemulugunyangako okuggyako eri Allah.
Nasindika batabani bange okuddayo okunoonya gwe nnali nfiiriddwa ne muganda we, nga mbakubiriza obutaggwaamu ssuubi.
Omukwasi w’amawulire amalungi bwe yatuuka, essaati yasuulibwa mu maaso gange, era amangu ago ensi n’eddamu okulabika obulungi.
Nze mmanyiddwa nga Isiraeri, era mu batabani bange ekkumi n’ababiri mwe mwava ebika ekkumi n’ebibiri eby’eggwanga eddene.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
